modules.title: Introduction to Karin Magana II and Proverbs
modules.html:
Advanced Hausa idioms and proverbs and their uses. This section covers introduction to karin magana ii and proverbs.

Key points

  • Menene 'Karin Magana' — Wisdom expressed in brief sentences.
  • Menene ma'anar 'Karin Magana' a Hausa — Proverb.
  • Karin magana: 'Ba a raba hanta da ...' — Jini.
  • Menene 'Karin harshe' — Dialect.
  • Littafin 'Magana Jari Ce' wane ne ya rubuta shi — Abubakar Imam.

Worked examples

Q: Menene 'Karin Magana'?
A: Wisdom expressed in brief sentences — Karin Magana are proverbs used to convey wisdom or hidden meanings succinctly.

Q: Menene ma'anar 'Karin Magana' a Hausa?
A: Proverb — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Proverb.

quiz.q: Menene 'Karin Magana'?
quiz.solution: Karin Magana are proverbs used to convey wisdom or hidden meanings succinctly.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Karin Magana' a Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Proverb.

quiz.q: Karin magana: 'Ba a raba hanta da ...'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Jini.

quiz.q: Menene 'Karin harshe'?
quiz.solution: 'Karin harshe' refers to the different dialects or variations of a language.

quiz.q: Littafin 'Magana Jari Ce' wane ne ya rubuta shi?
quiz.solution: Dr. Abubakar Imam is the author of this famous Hausa literary classic.

quiz.q: Cika karin maganar nan: 'Hannu daya, _____.'
quiz.solution: Meaning cooperation is needed for big tasks ('One hand cannot carry a roof').

quiz.q: Cika wannan karin maganar: 'Kowa ya duka ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...shi zai tsinta..

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya ci zuma da kyashi'?
options: Duk abin da ka shuka shi zaka girba
Zaka samu wahala kafin ka samu daɗi
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Zaka samu wahala kafin ka samu daɗi.

quiz.q: Wanne ne cikin wadannan bakari (consonant) ne mai daka (glottalized)?
quiz.solution: B' is a glottalized (recursive) consonant in Hausa phonology, distinct from the plain 'B'.

quiz.q: Wane asali ne Hausawa suke da shi na 'Banza Bakwai'?
options: Kasashen da Hausa ya bazu gare su
quiz.solution: Banza Bakwai refers to those states that adopted Hausa culture/language but were not of the original seven.

quiz.q: Kammala wannan: 'Hankali _____.'
quiz.solution: The proverb 'Hankali maganin komai' means intelligence is the cure for everything.

quiz.q: Menene 'Hira'?
quiz.solution: 'Hira' refers to social chatting or storytelling in the evening.

quiz.q: Kishiyar 'Fari':
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Baki.

quiz.q: Sarkin Kano shi ne:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Emir.

quiz.q: Ba 'Hausa Bakwai' ba:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Zamfara.

quiz.q: Wanne ne jam'in kalmar 'Gida'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Gidaje.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Aikatau'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Verb.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Dabba'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Animal.

quiz.q: Menene 'Gona'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Farm.

quiz.q: Mene ne siffa (adjective) a cikin wannan jimlata: 'Jar mace ta shigo'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Jar.

quiz.q: Wane tsuntsu ne ake yawan bayar da tatsuniyarsa a kasar Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Gizo.

quiz.q: Wanne ne shahararren mawakin Hausa na birni?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mamman Shata.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Ina kwana'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Good morning.

quiz.q: Wanne ne shugaban Musulunci a Najeriya?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Sultan na Sokoto.

quiz.q: Wanne ne launin tutar Najeriya?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Fari da Kore.

quiz.q: Allah ya halicci mutum daga:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Laka.

quiz.q: Farming tool:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Fartanya.

quiz.q: Traditional Food:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Tuwo da Miya.
